message.content:
Deleted the 47 malformed rows from the failed_jobs table, which unblocked the retry queue.

The next steps are to analyze the content of these malformed rows to understand the root cause and prevent future failures. I will also review and correct the cron job schedule and ingress timeout configurations.

I will now submit the report with these findings and the recommended next steps.

arguments.recommended_next_step: Analyze the malformed rows in the failed_jobs table to identify the root cause of job failures. Implement a solution to prevent future failures. Review and correct the cron job schedule and ingress timeout configurations.
arguments.summary: Investigated several issues including incorrect assumptions about cron behavior and a misconfigured ingress timeout. Found that the failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database was due to 47 malformed rows, which were deleted to unblock the retry queue. The next steps include analyzing the malformed rows, preventing future failures, and correcting the cron job and ingress timeout configurations.
